suggestion.action: Measure the regulator input voltage and inspect nearby input/output capacitors for failure.
suggestion.expected_result: If the 5V output is 0V, confirm whether the regulator input is present and stable.
suggestion.rationale: Zero on the 5V rail with a PSU board in view points to upstream feed or regulator/capacitor issues.
safety_notes: Be mindful of mains-derived rails on the power supply; verify isolation before probing.
